qualifier: PPAR signaling control, without fatty acid handling
name: Fat cell differentiation, PPAR signaling and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: All members concern white, brown and beige fat cell development, PPARG/PPAR signaling regulation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis; unlike its closest superset it lacks fatty acid transport, lipid droplet and leptin members, so the name stresses PPAR-regulated adipogenesis rather than lipid handling.

qualifier: fatty acid transport and lipid storage
name: Adipocyte development, thermogenesis and fatty acid transport
rationale: Members cover white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis plus fatty acid transport and cycling, lipid droplet fusion and the leptin-producing fat cell module, which distinguishes it from the otherwise identical differentiation-only theme and from the hepatic NR1H/ChREBP lipogenesis and lipid droplet confusables.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt signaling
qualifier: PORCN-dependent secretion and WNT5A/calcium branch only
name: PORCN-dependent Wnt secretion and WNT5A/calcium signaling
rationale: All members concern PORCN-dependent Wnt ligand biogenesis and secretion or the WNT5A-FZD2/5-ROR2 calcium branch of non-canonical signaling, with none of the canonical LRP5/DVL/TCF members of its superset theme or the planar polarity and Hedgehog lipidation members of other confusables.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and Wnt receptor signaling
qualifier: both calcium and LRP5/DVL canonical receptor branches
name: Wnt secretion with calcium and LRP5/DVL receptor signaling
rationale: Members span Wnt ligand biogenesis and Golgi secretion, the WNT5A/calcium non-canonical branch, and receptor-level canonical events (DVL activation, LRP5 mutants, ligand antagonists), which separates it from the secretion/calcium-only subset and from destruction-complex, RNF43 and retinal vascular confusables.
